```{r}

here::i_am("conbio/schedule.qmd")
source(here::here("_common.R"))
course_short <- str_extract(params$course, "\\w+(?=_)")
semester     <- str_remove(params$course, "\\w+_")


first <- semesters[[semester]][["start_class"]]
last  <- semesters[[semester]][["end_class"]]

```


```{r}
finals <-   tibble(
      Week  = 17,
      Date  = course_info[[params$course]][["final_exam"]]
    ) %>%
  mutate(Day = if_else(wday(Date) == course_info[[params$course]][["wdays"]][1], 1, 2))

blank_schedule  <- as.list(seq.Date(
  semesters[[semester]][["start_class"]], 
  semesters[[semester]][["end_class"]]
  )) %>% 
  map(\(x) ymd_hm(sprintf("%s %s", x, course_info[[params$course]][["start_time"]]), tz = "America/Chicago")) %>%
  discard(\(x) wday(x) %in% c(7, 1)) %>%
  set_names(rep(paste0("W", 1:16), each = 5)) %>%
  split(., names(.)) %>%
  map(\(x) keep(x, \(y) wday(y) %in% course_info[[params$course]][["wdays"]])) %>%
  map(\(x) set_names(x, paste0("D", seq_along(x)))) %>%
  enframe(name = "Week") %>%
  unnest_longer("value", indices_to = "Day", values_to = "Date") %>%
  mutate(across(c("Week", "Day"), ~as.integer(str_remove_all(., "[^\\d]")))) %>%
  select(Week, Day, Date) %>%
  arrange(Date) %>%
  bind_rows(finals)

save(blank_schedule, file = here(course_short, "blank_schedule.RData"))
```

case_convos <- list(
  "Case Conversation 1" = list(
    topic   = "Extinction",
    day     = "W4D2",
    leaders = c("Francesca Kerkhofs", "Zipporah Piper", "Sam Dillon")
  ),
  "Case Conversation 2" = list(
    topic = "Habitat Loss, Fragmentation, and Degradation",
    day   = "W6D1",
    leaders = c("Amanda Fagan", "Litzy Jaime", "Chloe Miller", "Joel Miller")
  ),
  "Case Conversation 3" = list(
    topic = "Overexploitation",
    day   = "W7D1",
    leaders = c("Hannah Pierson", "Lindy Slatten", "Grecia Torres")
  ),
  "Case Conversation 4" = list(
    topic = "Invasive Alien Species",
    day   = "W8D2",
    leaders = c("E Bradley", "Cian Hassovic", "Samuel Jacobsen", "Jameson Young")
  ),
  "Case Conversation 5" = list(
    topic = "Climate Change",
    day   = "W9D2",
    leaders = c("E Bradley", "Cian Hassovic", "Samuel Jacobsen", "Jameson Young")
  ),
  "Case Conversation 6" = list(
    topic = "Species-Level Approaches",
    day   = "W12D2",
    leaders = c("Amanda Fagan", "Litzy Jaime", "Chloe Miller", "Joel Miller")
  ),
  "Case Conversation 9" = list(
    topic = "Species-Level Approaches or Ex-Situ Conservation",
    day   = "W13D2",
    leaders = c("Quinton Vieyra")
  ),
  "Case Conversation 7" = list(
    topic = "Community & Ecosystem Approaches",
    day   = "W14D2",
    leaders = c("Hannah Pierson", "Lindy Slatten", "Grecia Torres")
  ),
  "Case Conversation 8" = list(
    topic = "Landscape-Scale Approaches",
    day   = "W15D2",
    leaders = c("Francesca Kerkhofs", "Zipporah Piper", "Sam Dillon")
  )
) %>%
  enframe(name = "case") %>%
  unnest_wider("value") %>%
  group_by(case, topic, day) %>%
  summarize(leaders = str_flatten_comma(unlist(leaders), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    case_id      = row_number(),
    case_display = as.character(str_glue("{row_number()}. {topic}")),
    Week = as.integer(str_extract(day, "(?<=^W)\\d+")),
    Day  = as.integer(str_extract(day, "(?<=D)\\d+$"))
    ) %>%
  select(
    Week,
    Day,
    case_id,
    case = topic,
    leaders
  )

save(case_convos, file = here("resources", course_short, "case_convos", "case_convos.RData"))

```{r}
#| context: data
#| include: false


case_card <- "<div class='card border-success mb-1 w-50'><div class='card-header'>Guided Case Conversation {case_id}</div><div class='card-body'><div class='d-flex w-100 justify-content-between'><strong class='card-text mb-1'>Topic:</strong><p class='card-text mb-1'>{case}</p></div><div class='d-flex w-100 justify-content-between'><strong class='card-text mb-1'>Leaders:</strong><p class='card-text mb-1'>{leaders}</p></div>"

film_card <- "<div class='card border-info mb-1 w-50'><div class='card-header'>Film</div><div class='card-body'><a href='{url}' target='_blank' class='card-link'><i class='fa-solid fa-link' style='padding: 7px;'></i>{film}</a></div></div>"

slides_link <- "<span class='nav-item'><a class='nav-link active' href='{slides}' target='_blank'><span class='text-info-emphasis'><i class='fa-solid fa-link' style='padding: 7px;'></i>{topic}</span></a></span>"

case_badge <- "<span class='badge bg-info'>Guided Case Conversation</span>"
film_badge <- "<span class='badge bg-secondary'>Film</span>"

schedule_data <- list(
  "Overview & Syllabus"                          = list("W1D1"),
  "The Rise of Conservation Biology"             = list("W1D2", "W2D2"),
  "Holiday"                                      = list("W2D1"),
  "Biodiversity Concepts & Measurement"          = list("W3D1", "W3D2", "W4D1", "W4D2"),
  "Extinction"                                   = list("W5D1", "W5D2", "W6D1"),
  "Habitat Loss, Fragmentation, and Degradation" = list("W6D2", "W7D1", "W7D2", "W8D2", "W9D1"),
  "Exam 1"                                       = list("W8D1"),
  "Overexploitation"                             = list("W9D2", "W11D1", "W11D2"),
  "Spring Break"                                 = list("W10D1", "W10D2"),
  "Invasive Alien Species"                       = list("W12D1", "W12D2"),
  "Climate Change"                               = list("W13D1", "W13D2", "W14D1"),
  "Ex Situ Conservation"                         = list("W14D2", "W15D1", "W15D2"),
  "Species-Level Approaches"                     = list("W16D1"),
  "Community & Ecosystem Approaches"             = list("W16D2"),
  "Landscape-Scale Approaches"                   = list("W16D2"),
  "Final Exam"                                   = list("W17D1")
) %>%
  enframe(name = "topic") %>%
  unnest_longer("value") %>%
  mutate(
    row = case_when(
      str_detect(topic, "Exam") ~ "dexam",
      str_detect(topic, "(Holiday)|(Break)") ~ "dnoclass",
      str_ends(value, "D1") ~ "d1",
      str_ends(value, "D2") ~ "d2",
      .default = "normal"
    )) %>%
  mutate(
    Week = as.integer(str_extract(value, "(?<=^W)\\d+")),
    Day  = as.integer(str_extract(value, "(?<=D)\\d+$")),
    .keep = "unused"
  ) %>%
  right_join(blank_schedule, by = c("Week", "Day")) %>%
  arrange(Date) %>%
  left_join(readings, by = "topic") %>%
  left_join(films, by = "topic") %>%
  left_join(slides, by = "topic") %>%
  left_join(case_convos, by = c("Week", "Day")) %>%
  mutate(
    Time = format(Date, "%I:%M %p"),
    Date = format(Date, "%a, %b %d")
    ) %>%
  mutate(
    topic = if_else(!is.na(slides), as.character(str_glue(slides_link)), topic),
    detail = case_when(
      !is.na(case) ~ as.character(str_glue(case_card)),
      is.na(case) & !is.na(film) ~ as.character(str_glue(film_card)),
    ),
    special = case_when(
      !is.na(case) ~ "Guided Case Conversation",
      is.na(case) & !is.na(film) ~ "Film"
    ),
    reading = if_else(reading == "", NA, reading)
  ) %>%
  select(
    Week,
    Date,
    Time,
    special,
    topic,
    reading,
    detail,
    row
  )

save(schedule_data, file = here(course_short, "schedule_data.RData"))
```

```{r}
#| include: false


merge_rows <- function() {
  JS("
    function(rowInfo, column, state) {
          const prevRow = state.pageRows[rowInfo.viewIndex - 1]
          if (prevRow && rowInfo.values[column.id] === prevRow[column.id]) {
            return { visibility: 'hidden' }
          }
      }
  ")
}

special_style <- function() {
  JS("
    function(cellInfo) {
    if (cellInfo.value && cellInfo.value === 'Guided Case Conversation') {
      return { backgroundColor: '#18bc9c', color: '#fff', fontWeight: 'bold', fontVariant: 'small-caps', border: '1px outset #fff' };
    } else if (cellInfo.value && cellInfo.value === 'Film') {
      return { backgroundColor: '#3498db', color: '#fff', fontWeight: 'bold', fontVariant: 'small-caps', border: '1px outset #fff' };
    }
    return ;
    }
     ")
}


special_class <- function() {
  JS("
    function(rowInfo) {
    if (rowInfo.values['special'] === 'Guided Case Conversation') {
      return 'table-success';
    } else if (rowInfo.values['special'] === 'Film') {
      return 'table-info';
    }
    }
     ")
}

topic_class <- function() {
  JS("
    function(rowInfo) {
    if (rowInfo.values['row'] === 'dexam') {
      return 'exam';
    } else {
      return ;
    }
    }
     ")
}

agenda_detail <- function() {
  JS("
  function(rowInfo) {
    if (rowInfo.values['special'] && rowInfo.values['special'].trim().length > 0) {
    return `<div style='margin: 10px 10px 25px 250px;'>${rowInfo.values['detail']}</div>`
    };
    return ;
  }
     ")
}

schedule <- reactable(
  schedule_data,
  theme           = flatly(),
  sortable        = FALSE,
  pagination      = FALSE,
  rowClass        = JS(" function(rowInfo) { return rowInfo.values['row'] } "),
  elementId       = "schedule",
  defaultColDef   = colDef(minWidth = 100, html = TRUE, style = merge_rows()),
  columns    = list(
    Week    = colDef("Wk"     , maxWidth = 50 ),
    Date    = colDef("Day"    , maxWidth = 120),
    special = colDef("Agenda" , details = agenda_detail(), style = special_style()),
    Time    = colDef("Time"   , minWidth = 50 ),
    topic   = colDef("Topic"  , minWidth = 150, class = topic_class()),
    reading = colDef("Reading"),
    detail  = colDef(show = FALSE),
    row     = colDef(show = FALSE)
  )
)

```
